points.description: Setup: labels the data as positive/negative classes (e.g. +1/−1) and initializes the weights (randomly or to some starting value).

Iterative learning loop: for each training point/epoch, if the point is misclassified (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for a correctly-signed/positive-oriented x), update the weights by adding eta*x (equivalently w += eta*y*x); repeat over epochs until the weights stop changing (or no misclassifications remain). Equivalent wording and correct equivalent update rules earn the mark.
